dataset.name: Olist - Insatisfaccion del cliente por pedido
dataset.business_domain: E-commerce marketplace (Brasil). Analisis de los aspectos de la gestion de pedidos asociados con la insatisfaccion del cliente, 2016-2025.
dataset.grain: Una fila representa un pedido (order_id) del datamart olist_master. Incluye pedidos con resena, con lineas o con ambas. Las resenas y las lineas ya estan agregadas por pedido.

non_additive_fields.name: score_prom
non_additive_fields.label: Average Review Score
non_additive_fields.reason: Review score is not additive; it represents the average score of reviews for a single order.

non_additive_fields.name: entrega_tarde
non_additive_fields.label: Late Delivery
non_additive_fields.reason: Counting late deliveries may duplicate entities because of the grain (order level).

ambiguities.description: The term 'pedido_bajo' is ambiguous. It could refer to a low-quality order or a low-value order. Clarification is needed.
The term 'cumplimiento_plazo' is ambiguous. It could refer to on-time delivery or fulfillment within a deadline. Clarification is needed.

validation_questions.question: Should 'entrega_tarde' be summed? It might duplicate entities due to the grain.
validation_questions.context: Counting late deliveries may duplicate entities because of the grain (order level).

validation_questions.question: Is'score_prom' additive? It seems to represent an average score for an order.
validation_questions.context: Review score is not additive; it represents the average score of reviews for a single order.
